source: tools offered to the model in `opencode run` (headless) runs against a scripted OpenAI-compatible provider with model IDs scripted (edit and write) and gpt-5-scripted (apply_patch), with OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA, OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_LSP_TOOL, OPENCODE_ENABLE_QUESTION_TOOL and OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_PLAN_MODE set and a local MCP server with resources, Linux x64. MCP tools (<server>_<tool>) are left out; invalid is opencode's stand-in for a call to a tool that doesn't exist, which reaches plugins too
